atk_order_note: Order by 공격력 (ATK), not 전투력 (power); Pomegranate is outside it. Macaron with ATK runes moves to #3, above Skating Queen.
perks: Leader Milk. 복지 (welfare): 열정페이 + 초고속승진, both on Milk. Mercenary squad Lv.4 opens the second welfare and third pet slots.
formation: No move speed on any rune or gear piece: it breaks Cherry's line.
substitutions: Tiger Lily → Herb if the team dies at the 30 s slam: 5 beams, so Tea Knight drops to Lv.1.
Cherry → Melon Soda if you're willing to tune move speed to 0.01 precision (see the Melon Soda deck).
Pet: Candy Shade Pouch once carries outlive the 17 s wipe; Panda Dumpling while the team dies there (HP 5–9M).
Cherry → Popcorn (Lv.60, no move speed), fillers Lv.50: 1T 150G at 1.86G, one poster's best; single source.
Scorpion → Herb Lv.1, Cherry and Tiger Lily kept: 9 of 10 runs line up at ~500×, lower ceiling; 1T 459G at 2.5G.
rng: 1T in 1–2 of 10 runs at 1.74G, 1.1T occasionally. At 0.97G: 150× floor, 250–350× average, 400×+ after 14 h of macro.
unorthodox: Five cookies at Lv.1, including the damage-dealer Scorpion in some versions and the buffer Pomegranate in the #1 run.
An R-rarity Cherry Cookie in an endgame team, purely for formation.
Scorpion levelled to a precise ATK window as a beam catcher rather than as a dealer.

obsolete.reason: Chardonnay's crit buff covers the whole line, so Cherry's formation job is gone; from 9★ she beats Macaron: 4T 300G at Lv.118 vs 2T 186G at Lv.100. Counter-case: an 8★ lost to a 9★ Macaron, 3.6T to 3.8T.

ceiling: ≥4T 647G in battle; best final 4T 300G at 4.29G (≈1000×), Season 7
